name: walkie-talkie
//workspaces: mcp-server precedes hub deliberately: `npm run build --workspaces` runs them in this order, and hub now typechecks against mcp-server's emitted .d.ts files (it imports registerRadioTools to host the radio tools over Streamable HTTP). Reversing this order fails a clean build while an incremental one keeps passing, which is the worst kind of green.

scripts.start: npm start --workspace=hub & HUB_PID=$!; sleep 1; if ! kill -0 $HUB_PID 2>/dev/null; then wait $HUB_PID; exit $?; fi; if [ -n "$WALKIE_TALKIE_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN" ]; then npm start --workspace=@walkie-talkie/slack-bot & fi; wait
